This work is not started. The site must not show a vote until it is copied from a primary public record.

## Who

- James Talarico, U.S. Senate. Possible sources: Congress.gov and Senate roll calls.
- Gina Hinojosa, Governor of Texas. Possible sources: Texas bill signings and vetoes.

## What you are proposing

A source, a schema, or a way to link one real vote to one stored promise. Leave the link off when the connection is not clear.

## Primary record

Paste the URL of a real roll call, signing, or veto. Do not invent a bill number or an outcome.

## Promise it relates to

Optional. Link a promise already in the ledger, and say why this vote bears on it. If you are not sure, say so.

## What not to include

No sample rows, no guessed votes, and no score that treats a missing link as "unrelated."
